answer: Make every identity post a refundable stake and keep a lantern-bright public ledger of it. Voting weight scales with stake, not headcount, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand deposits. Each quill-written answer is checked by peers; a copied or junk one forfeits its stake, so every sybil costs real capital and gets burned on detection. A steady pulse of fresh challenges stops attackers from reusing one answer across identities.
